title: festuca arvernensis subsp. costei
intro: Festuca arvernensis subsp. costei, commonly known as Coste's fescue, is a plant species in the grass family Poaceae. It is native to Europe, and its use in traditional medicine has been documented for its potential health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Festuca arvernensis subsp. costei are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, making it useful for wound healing and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
